subject: Campus Ambassador Promo Bundles — proofs, partial backorder & expedited options
messages:
From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@mintprintco.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proofs + updated lead times for ambassador bundles

Hi Irene —

Attached are the v3 proofs for the campus ambassador bundles (PDF) and the updated cost/lead-time spreadsheet. Two quick notes:

- Production: our embroidery lines that do the beanies are at capacity the week of Aug 9–15. We can keep your full order in the standard schedule but the embroidered beanies (style B-12) will slip ~3 weeks (estimated availability: Sep 8).
- Option: we can do a split fulfillment — ship 400 bundles with woven patch beanies (in-hand Aug 2) and expedite a separate run of 200 embroidered beanies with priority tooling (additional $3/unit) to meet Aug 20 delivery. Expedited slots are limited.

Please review the proof for badge packaging (we made a tighter insert per your layout notes) and the alternate sample photos for the tan beanie (we swapped thread color from #6A4E2B to #6B4C2A to better match the patch).

Attachments: ambassador_bundle_v3_proof.pdf (10 pages), quote_mintprint_7-14.xlsx

If you want to proceed with split fulfillment we need written confirmation by end of day Thu 7/16 to secure the expedited slot.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Lee
Account Manager 
MintPrint Co.
phone: (415) 555-0193
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@mintprintco.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proofs + updated lead times for ambassador bundles

Thanks Sam — appreciate the quick turnaround and the options. Team —

Quick context: these bundles go to our campus ambassador kickoff (on-site shipping to campus hubs) the week of Aug 23; we need at least 500 complete bundles on-site by Aug 24 for regional kickoff events. We originally asked for 600 total (500 primary + 100 reserve).

Decision points I need from you by Thu EOD so I can confirm with MintPrint and the venue:
- Do we approve split fulfillment (400 standard + 200 expedited) at +$3/unit for expedited beanies?
- If not splitting, do we accept the woven patch beanie alternative for all units to meet Aug 2 delivery?
- Budget approval: who signs off on the extra expedite cost? (Aditya)

If we go with split fulfillment, we also need to confirm who handles on-site kitting if expedited run arrives separately (MintPrint can provide a kitting/fulfillment partner at cost).

Please read the attached proof and call out any design issues (badge sizing, insert folds) in-line. Sam — can you confirm revised ETA for the 400/200 split (ship dates + carrier options + per-shipment tracking IDs once available)?

Irene Choi
Senior Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@mintprintco.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proofs + updated lead times for ambassador bundles

Irene —

My preference is to avoid full redesign (we already changed the insert once) so I lean to the split-fulfill approach: 400 standard + 200 expedited. 200 expedited at +$3/unit is acceptable if procurement confirms costs against event budget.

Aditya — can you confirm we have the extra $600 (200 * $3) plus any expedited freight? If procurement needs to re-route funds I can ask for a one-time ambassador event overage from marketing.

Design note: the tan beanie thread color in the proof looks fine to me under the lighting notes Sam provided — I don't think a reproof is needed.

Monica
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@mintprintco.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proofs + updated lead times for ambassador bundles

Short — procurement can approve the $600 expedite premium (charge to event code FM-2026-Q3) and up to $1,200 in expedited freight, provided MintPrint sends an amended quote and we get a signed SOW/PO by Thu 7/16 EOD.

Two additional options if we need capacity insurance:
- Split the embroidery run across MintPrint and a secondary vendor (LocalStitch). LocalStitch can do 200 units embroidered with a 9-day turnaround but will require a separate PO and slightly different stitch spec.
- Approve woven patch beanie for all 600 units to avoid expedite expense (cheapest, fastest).

If you want me to route an emergency PO I can start the DocuSign now — ping me with final qty and vendor selection.

Aditya Rao
Senior Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@mintprintco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Emily Gardner <emily@campusfest.org>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 17:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Proofs + updated lead times for ambassador bundles

Sam — thank you. Team has confirmed direction:

1) Proceed with split fulfillment as proposed: 400 bundles shipped under standard schedule (use woven patch beanie for those 400 to avoid additional slip risk) and expedite 200 embroidered beanies at +$3/unit.
2) Procurement will approve the expedite premium and up to $1,200 expedited freight (Aditya will issue PO). Please send an amended quote and updated production schedule (dates and carrier options) by EOD Mon 7/19 so we can finalize the PO.
3) MintPrint to provide an updated packing_list_draft.csv with lot IDs and per-carton counts for both shipments. We need the expedited parcel to be kitted as complete bundles (not bulk beanie bags) so campus hubs can receive and distribute immediately.
4) Emily — FYI: we may have a second delivery arriving Aug 18–20; can CampusFest receiving accept a two-part delivery and hold the expedited run in your receiving bay until Aug 22? If not, please confirm alternate on-site storage options.

Sam — once you confirm the amended quote I'll approve the split-fulfill plan formally. Thanks again for the fast options.

Irene Choi
Senior Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference
